name: Whisparr Sync
summary: Keeps Cove in step with the Whisparr instance you configure, calling out to it with an API key you supply and Cove holds server-side. Connect to either Whisparr generation, test the connection, and register Cove's import callback so what Whisparr imports reaches your library. Monitor and unmonitor a studio or a performer from its own Cove page, or a whole selection at once. From that same menu, register the scenes Cove holds that Whisparr does not and ask Whisparr to link files you already own into place; neither downloads anything. One separately named action, Search all monitored, asks Whisparr to search and download - it acts on one entity at a time and is not offered for a selection. A Missing tab on studio pages, and on performer pages where a Whisparr v3 (Eros) connection is configured, lists the scenes the connected Whisparr's catalogue holds that your library does not, and marks one scene or a page of scenes wanted without downloading anything; its own Search action asks Whisparr for a single scene and does download. Filling that tab calls outward to the metadata source Cove is configured with, using the key Cove already holds for it, and your browser fetches each cover image straight from that source. A button in the videos, studios and performers list toolbars puts a read-only badge on each card of the page saying what the connected instance holds for that scene, studio or performer. It asks the instance once per card, over one page of cards at most, and writes nothing. A Whisparr tab on a scene's page in Cove states what the connected instance holds for that scene: its state, the quality of any file the instance holds, the quality profile it applies and that profile's cutoff. From that tab you add the scene, monitor or unmonitor it, or put it on the instance's exclusion list and take it back off; none of those downloads anything. One separately named control there, Search now, asks the instance to search for that scene and download what it finds. A Whisparr button in the videos selection bar applies one of those five actions to every scene you selected, as one background job reporting counts, bounded at 1000 scenes in one run and at 100 for the searching row. Both surfaces need a Whisparr v3 (Eros) connection and are absent on Whisparr v2. One endpoint answers anonymously - the import callback Whisparr posts to - and it is authenticated by a secret this extension mints rather than by a Cove permission; every other endpoint requires one.
